close_reason: Opinion (per SEC4): commit granularity preference; commit already made
description: The commit bundles six separate refactors (sort early return, take_fault rename, two variable renames in mailbox.rs, borrow simplification, seed comments, test oracle label). A reader doing git blame on any one of these files must read the entire commit to find the relevant change. git bisect across a regression in seed_fixture_tests.rs would also implicate mailbox.rs changes. This is a reviewability issue, not taste: each logically independent change should be a separate commit so blame and bisect stay meaningful. Flagging as a pattern to avoid in future PRs.
title: six unrelated changes in one commit obscures individual change rationale
